text:
mira: Need a quick decision: what is the minimal alpha scope for the Optimize Toolkit pilot we can commit to this quarter? Customers pressing for trials.

sam: Recommend minimal: (A) batching recs API with p50/p95 and token-savings estimate, (B) prefix-cache suggestion + measurement endpoint, (C) quantization report (expected quality delta + throughput), (D) eval-alert adapter that pushes webhooks when a metric regresses past threshold. No auto-apply.

leo: Agreed. I'll deliver a small model-compatibility table marking safe quant modes and a short bench for 3 models. Will flag any models we must exclude.

anya: CS asks each rec include one-line rationale + confidence (low/med/high) and an "accept toggle" workflow in the dashboard. Pilot customers will not allow silent changes.

jordan: Sales needs a canary path + auto-fallback to hosted inference if p95 or error rate crosses configured SLOs. Also want a one-page runbook we can hand to accounts.

sam: Example smoke check we can use for pilots: curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/optimize/suggest -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"route":"chat-checkout","seq_len":128,"model":"redwood-mx-7b"}' -> expect batching, cache, quant_report, explanation, confidence, measurement_endpoint.

mira: Gating numbers proposal: quality drop <=1.5% on primary metric, +10% token reduction OR >=10% p50 improvement for value, alerts default to 5% regression. These are negotiable but need anchors.

leo: For quant reports, include which eval metric was used and sample size. If results are noisy, add a "uncertain" flag.

anya: Pilot checklist for CS: onboarding doc, contact matrix, 2-week schedule, baseline vs pilot dashboard, rollback tested, SRE contact.

sam: Rough ETA: rec APIs + measurement endpoints 3w, quant bench 1.5w, eval-alert adapter 1.5w, dashboard stub + toggle 1.5w. Parallel work -> ~4-5w alpha.

pilot-bot: pilot-bot: reserved a deploy window 2024-07-01 03:00 UTC for pilot infra.

mira: Decision: lock minimal alpha to items above unless objections. Please react with :thumbsup: if you can deliver by ETA or list blockers. Scope sign-off by COB Fri.
